pages.text: $(l)Fire Extinguisher$()$(br)Hold right-click to spray $(item)dry ice flakes$(), one per tick. A full extinguisher holds $(item)500 flakes$(), about 25 seconds of spraying.

$(li)A flake that hits a block $(item)puts out every fire$() within 1 block of the impact (config $(item)fireExtinguisherClearRadius$()). That includes the green and blue fires of the grenades.$(li)A flake that hits a creature puts it out, $(item)removes Hellfire$(), slows it and freezes it; enough flakes start to hurt.
Refill it with a $(item)spout$() and 1000 mB of carbon dioxide: the CO2 your engines, fireboxes and coke ovens produce finally has a use.

$(l)Lithium Torch$()$(br)A lithium ingot above an aluminium ingot gives 4 $(item)Lithium Torches$(). They give light level 14, go on floors, walls and ceilings, and can be $(item)placed underwater$(), where a normal torch cannot.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
